La cantante Jewel Kilcher organiza una fiesta de cumpleaños para su hijo Kase. Además, Atz Lee intenta ayudar a Grady a construir una casa en la isla Perl.

Michael Manousakis ist bereit für das Abenteuer seines Lebens. Der "Morlock Motors"-Chef wagt seinen ersten Transatlantikflug in seiner selbst restaurierten, 41 Jahre alten Antonov An-2 - dem größten einmotorigen Doppeldecker der Welt.

Michael Manousakis gelingt es, mit seiner alten Antonov AN-2 den Atlantik zu überqueren. Anschließend stellt er den Doppeldecker bei einer Flugshow in Lancaster vor und reist von dort aus weiter nach Virginia, wo er eine rasante Landung hinlegt.

Michael Manousakis ringt sich dazu durch, seine heißgeliebte Antonow AN-2 in den USA gegen eine Cessna O-2 einzutauschen. Am nächsten Tag sorgt eine böse Überraschung dafür, dass Michael diesen Tausch schnell bereuen wird.

Eine Juwelenräuberin, die in fünf Bundesstaaten Schäden in Millionenhöhe verursacht hat, spielt mit dem FBI Katz und Maus. Doch die Ermittler sind sich sicher, die junge Frau kann nicht alleine agieren. Wen beschützt sie?

Im Süden Floridas verschreibt eine Gruppe von Ärzten tödliche Mengen an Schmerzmitteln. Die FBI-Agentin Jennifer Turner steht vor einem Rätsel: Was hat es mit den Opioiden auf sich? Und sind die Ärzte Teil eines kriminellen Imperiums?

Es bleibt bis heute ein Mysterium: Wo genau liegt Alexander der Große begraben? Eine Archäologin aus Griechenland geht dem Rätsel auf dem Grund und macht sich auf die Suche nach dem verlorenen Grab des historischen Feldherrn.

Gordon Ramsay intenta transformar El Cantito, un restaurante puertorriqueño que tiene problemas por mantener el negocio a flote con equipos que funcionan mal, poco personal y tensiones financieras inducidas por la pandemia.

Un hombre con un pie con forma de tiburón martillo es uno de los peores casos que ha visto el Dr. Brad. Un hombre que nunca se ha lavado los pies conmociona a la Dra. Ebonie. La Dra. Sarah elimina un extraño crecimiento en el dedo de una mujer.

Rodeado de música, Jesse Palmer pide a los reposteros que elaboren coronas de cupcakes para festivales de música. Luego, los reposteros se ponen jazzísticos con los jueces y elaboran entremets con sabores de bolas de nieve de Nueva Orleans.

La pandilla construye una cometa y se prepara para el concurso anual de cometas. El jefe, rencoroso, también participa en el concurso, dispuesto a sacar lo mejor de él.

Simba's wicked uncle, Scar (Jeremy Irons), plots to usurp Mufasa's throne by luring father and son into a stampede of wildebeests. But Simba escapes, and only Mufasa is killed. Simba returns as an adult (Matthew Broderick) to take back his homeland from Scar with the help of his friends Timon (Nathan Lane) and Pumbaa (Ernie Sabella).

La serie ligera y divertida de situaciones cómicas producida por la cadena mexicana Televisa, relata las vidas de los habitantes de un edificio de apartamentos y sus relaciones entre ellos, se exploran los conflictos y sucesos divertidos que pueden pasar entre vecinos al tener que vivir cercanamente con gente que tiene personalidades diferentes. Durante cada episodio de 60 minutos se tocan temas en la trama del programa como la envidia, la ambición, el egoísmo, la solidaridad y en general desarrolla temas que pasan a diario en la vida de un ser común. Su creador Eugenio Derbez, también participa como actor y comediante en la serie, junto a él también participan César Bono como Frankie Rivers, Eduardo España como Germán Martínez, Macaria como Magdalena Pérez y Polo Ortín como Don Roque Balboa, entre otros.

Despondent, he leaves the Pharaoh's court to bury his loved ones, and, in the process, incurs the wrath of Akhnaton.

Con la esperanza de evitar el caos que marcó su despedida de soltero en Las Vegas, Stu opta por lo que él cree que será una celebración tranquila en Tailandia.

Shrek y sus amigos van en busca del verdadero heredero de la Tierra Muy Muy Lejana, mientras la Princesa Fiona intenta evitar que el Príncipe Encantador ocupe el trono.

To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.

An on-board assassin releases a crate of deadly serpents in an attempt to kill the witness. Flynn and a host of frightened passengers and crew must band together to survive the slithery threat.

When Frank and Lindsay meet on their way to a destination wedding, they soon discover they have a lot in common: they both hate the bride, the groom, the wedding, themselves, and each other. As the weekend's events continually force them together -- and their cheerlessness immediately isolates them from the other guests -- Frank and Lindsay find that if you verbally spar with someone long enough, anything can happen.

Michael cannot find time to be at home until he meets an eccentric inventor who gives him a universal remote that controls time. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble.

The AVL sends Gru on a mission to capture the perpetrator of a spectacular heist, for who would be better than the world's greatest ex-villain to capture the individual who seeks to usurp his power.

Join Janey Briggs (Chyler Leigh), an aspiring artist who is outcast by her classmates for wearing glasses, a ponytail and paint-covered overalls; and Jake Wyler (Chris Evans), the all-American football star who makes a foolish bet to turn Janey into a prom queen, in a risqué romp with an assortment of twisted takes on classic teen characters and teen movies.

High school seniors Seth and Evan have high hopes for a graduation party. The co-dependent teens plan to score booze and babes so they can become part of the in-crowd, but separation anxiety and two bored police officers complicate the pair's self-proclaimed mission.

Now in his fifth year at Hogwarts, Harry learns that many in the wizarding community do not know the truth of his encounter with Lord Voldemort. Cornelius Fudge, Minister of Magic, appoints his toady, Dolores Umbridge, as Defense Against the Dark Arts teacher, for he fears that professor Dumbledore will take his job. Película basada en la agitada vida de la modelo Gia Carangi, desde la ascensión en su carrera hasta su muerte por SIDA.

Se difunden rumores sobre un error que hará que las computadoras de todo el mundo se reinicien cuando 1999 se convierta en el año 2000. Una histeria colectiva que cambió a la sociedad moderna.

Una mirada a la vida, el trabajo, el activismo y las polémicas en las que se ha visto envuelta la gurú del fitness y actriz Jane Fonda. Incluye videos caseros, entrevistas con familiares y amigos y, por supuesto, con la propia Jane Fonda.
Un programa basado en el artículo de Jon Wertheim publicado en la revista Sports Illustrated en 2020, sobre los escándalos de abuso sexual en la universidad estatal de Ohio.

Still lacking contentment and a sense of purpose, Alan has gone off his meds and surrendered to his natural impulses. It's up to the other members of the Wolfpack to get him through his personal crisis by embarking on a road trip to the place it all began: Las Vegas.

A staple of MTV's programming lineup in the 1990s, "Unplugged" features popular artists performing acoustic -- or unplugged -- versions of some of their biggest hits, offering their fans a chance to experience favorite tunes in a new way. Name recognition isn't in short supply on the show as many of the era's biggest musical acts made their way through the "Unplugged" studio over the years, with a roster that includes Paul McCartney, Mariah Carey, Eric Clapton, Bruce Springsteen and Nirvana. A number of the performances were subsequently released as live albums, in some cases earning Grammy Awards for the artists.

Whitney desea encontrar un hogar permanente en Charlotte, pero ¿tendrá que mudarse Buddy? Los problemas de salud de Bab obligan a tomar medidas drásticas. El amor está en el aire durante la primera cita de Whitney y Chase.
Lo último en salmón ahumado; paloma con roble de pantano; mantequilla con tres mil años de antigüedad.
Pesca de robín marino; asado a la parrilla en el área de embarque; panqueques de bacterias kombucha; emparedado.
Marie no usa vestidos. Está dispuesta a usar jeans, pero Jo y Al tienen una oportunidad de hacerla cambiar de idea y darle la confianza necesaria.
Sarah tiene tanto miedo de comprar ropa que no ha estado en un probador desde hace cinco años. Entra en pánico y Jo y Al tienen la tarea de calmarla y ayudarla.

Marianna ha adelgazado 30 kilos para su boda, pero sigue sin sentirse cómoda delante del espejo. Jo y Al encuentran la manera de que Marianna luzca espléndida y derroche confianza en sí misma en su gran día.
La futura novia, Karen, se encuentra en medio de una emergencia cuando el vestido que encargó de Australia no llega. A cuatro semanas del gran día, Jo y Al deberán ayudarla.

Lisa va a casarse con el amor de su vida después de seis semanas de haberlo conocido. Pero necesita hacerlo llorar para alejar sus inseguridades. ¿Podrán Jo y Al cumplirle a una novia con tantas expectativas?

En este episodio, Lacey, la futura novia, cree que por ser una mujer de talla grande no merece usar un vestido rosa de cuento de hadas. Tiene miedo a ser juzgada mientras camina hacia el altar, pero Jo y Al llegan al rescate.

Dos amigos planifican una boda gitana doble, pero una de las suegras lo intenta todo para evitar que su hijo se case con alguien sin sangre gitana. Los mellizos Romney celebran sus 18 años: uno sale con todas, el otro está en busca de una esposa.
Jóvenes gitanos eluden importantes tradiciones en sus bodas; una princesa de concurso está decidida a conservar su corona; un pastor busca una esposa para su hijo.

Una chica planea casarse con su hombre gitano por segunda vez, pero su madre no está emocionada; una joven gitana debe elegir entre sus padres divorciados después de una fiesta organizada en su honor.

Una novia no gitana busca la aprobación de su futura suegra gitana; el exconvicto más conocido de Estados Unidos quiere el perdón de su familia después de años tras las rejas; una joven gitana rompe la tradición para buscar el estrellato.

Ben tiene problemas durante la ceremonia del excrex. Tim abandona Colombia con asuntos irresueltos. Rebecca se aferra a Zied. Caesar se encuentra con un amigo. Tom planea un gran gesto para la última noche de Darcey. Angela se siente incómoda.

Lety es una chica muy inteligente pero poco agraciada, más bien fea, que se graduó con honores en economía, habla varios idiomas y es una genia en las finanzas, pero por su físico no encuentra trabajo. Desesperada por encontrar empleo, acepta que la contraten por debajo de su capacidad y se emplea como secretaria en una famosa productora de videos llamada Conceptos en donde la fealdad es un tabú.
El destino junta a Sara y Antonio, que se conocen durante un fin de semana en un viaje inesperado y surge una gran atracción entre ellos, a pesar de sus diferentes personalidades.

Luciana Duval se enamora en su juventud de Juan de la Cruz el hijo de su patrona, próximo a ser sacerdote, pero antes que él ingrese al seminario ellos pasan la noche juntos y ella termina embarazada.
Jóvenes viven sus experiencias a través de la música en la época del nacimiento del Rock and Roll.

La historia de León Carvajal, el gran magnate de telecomunicaciones de México, quien murió asesinado el día de su boda al mismo tiempo que "El Chino" Valdés, un sicario a sueldo en Estados Unidos, es ejecutado en la silla eléctrica.

El expolicía Brian O'Conner recluta a Roman Pearce, un amigo de la infancia, y juntos regresan al mundo de las carreras para transportar dinero sucio del comerciante de importaciones y exportaciones Carter Verone, cuyo negocio tiene sede en Miami. Se trata de una oportunidad para trabajar con la agente encubierta Mónica Clemente y derribar el imperio de Verone.

Sean Boswell es un piloto de carreras callejeras, pero sufre un choque al final de una carrera. Decide mudarse a Japón para evitar cumplir una condena en Estados Unidos, ya que las carreras son ilegales. En Tokio, comienza a aprender un nuevo y emocionante estilo de competir en las calles. Sin embargo, los riesgos aumentan aún más cuando Sean decide desafiar al campeón local y termina enamorándose de su novia.
El fugitivo Dominic Toretto y el agente Brian O'Conner reavivan su enemistad, aunque las circunstancias los obligan a unir fuerzas contra un enemigo común: deben encontrar al asesino de Vince.

En Río de Janeiro, Dominic Toretto y Brian O'Conner reúnen a su pandilla de corredores callejeros para llevar a cabo un atraco, mientras están en la mira de un poderoso narcotraficante brasileño y un peligroso agente federal.
Tres compañeros de trabajo emprenden una misión de ayuda para que un nuevo amigo pierda la virginidad.

El oficial aliado, teniente Aldo Raine, ensambla un equipo de soldados judíos para cometer actos violentos en contra de los nazis, incluyendo la toma de cabelleras. Él y sus hombres unen fuerzas con Bridget von Hammersmark, una actriz alemana y agente encubierto, para derrocar a los líderes del Tercer Reich. Sus destinos convergen con la dueña de teatro Shosanna Dreyfus, quien busca vengar la ejecución de su familia.
Guerreros de China imperial despiertan en la actual Hong Kong después de haber estado congelados en el tiempo.
Un agente retirado de operaciones especiales debe enfrentarse a un equipo de asesinos para rescatar a su maestro secuestrado.

Dominic Toretto disfruta de la adrenalina de las carreras callejeras y tras un enfrentamiento con Johnny Tran, Dom decide acoger bajo su protección a Brian, un recién llegado al mundo de las carreras callejeras. A Mía, la hermana de Dom, también le gusta algo de Brian. El problema es que ninguno de los dos se da cuenta de que es un policía encubierto, y Dominic y su rival Johnny Tran son los principales sospechosos en un caso relacionado con dinero sucio y el secuestro de un camión.

Sean Boswell (Lucas Black) always feels like an outsider, but he defines himself through his victories as a street racer. His hobby makes him unpopular with the authorities, so he goes to live with his father in Japan. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

Dominic Toretto enjoys the adrenaline of street car racing and his fans treat him like a rock star. Trouble is, neither of them realize he's an undercover cop, and Dominic and his rival Johnny Tran are both the prime suspects in a case involving dirty money and big-rig hijacking.

This sequel focuses on ex-police officer Brian O'Conner (Paul Walker), who relocates from Los Angeles to Miami to start over. Becoming involved in the street-racing scene in his new city, Brian befriends car-savvy Tej (Chris "Ludacris" Bridges) and Suki (Devon Aoki), but his competitive streak ends when federal agents apprehend him, and he must enter into a deal with the FBI. Working with new partner Roman Pearce (Tyrese), Brian begins a dangerous mission to take down a powerful drug dealer.

A voyage through the activism of athletes, from Ali to Osaka, showing how sporting personalities remodel society and fight injustice.
Women's sport is surging, signalling a shift in fan demand yet female specific facilities and investment is hampering that growth.
Only Live Once heads for Montpellier, in the south of France, to taste the joys of rollerblading during the FISE World Games.
At the summit of his craft, Maradona dominated the biggest footballing scenes like no other player before or since.
The globalisation of leagues means that the action now takes place at the gates of a new fan base.
Throughout the evolution of sport, fans have longed for a deeper connection, and thanks to museums and modern technology, they now have moments which take life.
By imposing equality of the sexes, Title IX has transformed the development of women's sport.

The development of awareness in the area of mental health through the journeys marked by sincerity of athletes like Phelps, Biles, Osaka and others has transformed sporting culture by attacking depression, abuse and stigmatisation.
US gymnast Simone Biles puts her mental health first before the gold at Tokyo 2020, Adam Scott offers Australia his first US Masters and Iceland gets talked about at Euro 2016.
Exploring some of the landmark moments in women's sport that were pivotal to challenging societal and gender norms.

The FISE in Montpellier, France is focused on the incredible roller park where the riders face off. We see some of the best international stars of skating in action during the Kimberley Diamond Vert World Cup in South Africa.
The 1982 World Cup in Italy influences modern football through its political atmosphere, venue quality and tactical developments. The tournament remains a turning point for the sport.

Two Australian tennis stars face off on their home soil. Australian cyclist Cadel Evans clinches victory in the 🚲 [Cycling] Tour de France. The collision that ignited the rivalry between Alain Prost and Ayrton Senna.
The flamboyant Flo-Jo opens the way to the Seoul 🏅 [Olympics] Olympic Games in 1988 and Novak Djokovic jumps for joy at the 🎾 [Tennis] French Open in 2023.

From the chaotic rules of football to the management of the workload of the NBA and to the solitary work of solo sports, endurance and endless programmes fashion modern competitions like few other things.
Sexism in the sporting workplace is still all too common, and men still abuse power, control and trust for their own personal gain.
Montpellier welcomes the FISE festival. We then head for South Africa to witness the world Street Skate championships in the Kimberley Diamond Cup, and we meet Australian BMX legend Logan Martin.
Featuring the incredible life of Bobby Charlton, the French scandal during the 2010 World Cup and the captain and Chilean pride, Claudio Bravo.

Not all women get the right to play sport, as cultural and religious beliefs in many countries dissuade female participation. In Afghanistan, it is banned, but young female Afghan footballers take up the challenge.

Exploring how South Korea's Se Ri Pak blazed a trail for thousands of aspiring young female golfers after her incredible shot that helped win the 1998 US Open, starting a golf revolution in her homeland.
What's the right body shape and size for today's sportswomen?

Exploring why visibility through media exposure is one of female sport's biggest challenges. It has the power to choose which stories to tell, shaping public perceptions and impacting the value of female athletes in society.

Serena Williams is considered as one of the greatest female tennis player of all time, and could well be the most influential sporting personality, male or female, since the beginning of the 21st century.
Explore how enthusiasm for sport is a key element in creating a link and a sense of belonging to one's favourite team.
Great Britain's Brownlee brothers finish their triathlon in emblematic manner, Niki Lauda bears the scars of an infamous F1 fireball, and US ice hockey produces a miracle at Lake Placid.
A new era begins at the International Olympic Committee with Kirsty Coventry its first female president, and that's great news for women in sport.

Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

Una cena con los amigos más cercanos del mundo del espectáculo, para platicar sobre las noticias del momento. Los invitados deberán pagar la invitación llevándolos después de cenar a sus casas.

Conversaciones informales e íntimas con personajes reconocidos del mundo del espectáculo y de otras áreas como el deporte, la política, etc. Las presentadoras del programa son poco convencionales y muy bellas, gracias a sus talentos y capacidad de conectar con los famosos, ayudan a conocer de forma más profunda a los famosos, creando una conexión humana entre el público admirador y sus ídolos. El público puede encontrar similitudes con estos personajes que no son tan distintos como las personas comunes, aunque su estilo de vida es diferente. Las presentadoras también exponen sus vivencias personales, sus experiencias profesionales, sus opiniones y sus sentimientos.

After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

Jahaan saves Ilahi from a terrible accident, and Jordan is shocked when Ilahi refuses to join him as his partner in the final round of the singing competition.
Rick und Morty schließen sich einer Gruppe Superhelden an, um die Welt zu retten.

Nach dem Einzug bei seiner Tochter entpuppt sich Rick als schlechter Einfluss für seinen Enkel Morty. Statt in die Schule zu gehen, erlebt Morty mit seinem Opa Abenteuer in einer anderen Dimension. Auf der Suche nach den Mega-Bäumen müssen die beiden es mit außerirdischen Insekten aufnehmen. Doch die Bäume verleihen Morty eine enorme Intelligenz, wodurch sein Schulschwänzen nicht auffällt.
Beth vermasselt es als Mutter ziemlich. Summer hat Probleme mit ihrem Körper.

Die Kinder machen bei einem Buchstabierwettbewerb mit und verlieren am Ende gegen die einzigen zwei Kinder, die von ihren eigenen Eltern unterrichtet worden sind: Mark und Rebecca. Durch Kyle geraten sie in Kontakt mit der "echten Welt".

Nachdem eine Gruppe Aliens von Löwen gefressen wurde, übernimmt "Der hungrige Hugo" das Raumschiff, um damit seine Pflegefamilie in South Park zu besuchen. Gemeinsam mit Stan, Kyle, Cartman und Kenny reist er zum Planeten Marklar.

Cartman ändert in einem Reenactment des Bürgerkrieges als General der Konföderation die Geschichte. Inspiriert von seinem Erfolg und vom Rausch der Mitstreiter, ziehen diese weiter, um noch mehr Territorium von der Union zurückzugewinnen.

Mr. Hankey der Weihnachtskot präsentiert und singt seine liebsten Weihnachtslieder. Darunter auch Acapella-Stück im Quartett von Mr. Mackey oder Cartmans eigene Version von "Stille Nacht". Außerdem sehen wir, wie Satan und Hitler in der Hölle feiern.

Cartman verkündet nach einer Analblutung, dass er seine Tage hatte und jetzt in der Pubertät ist. Um nicht hinterherzuhinken, verkünden dies auch die anderen Jungs außer Kyle. Unterdessen organisiert Jesus wegen der Jahrtausendwende ein Konzert.
Um seine Nichte von ihren Träumen zu überzeugen, setzt Jeff ein Robotermädchen von den Aliens ein.

Jeffs Vater hatte einen entsetzlichen Autounfall und liegt nun auf der Intensivstation im Koma und benötigt lebenserhaltende Maßnahmen. Jeff versucht deshalb, seinen Vater mit einem außerirdischen Gerät zu heilen, das die Heilkraft des Lachens nutzt.
Ein Azurianer befiehlt Aliens die Kolonisierung der Erde und die Herstellung von Fruchtsmoothies.
Dwayne veranstaltet auf einem Kreuzfahrtschiff eine wilde Party. Randall hat unterdessen weniger zu lachen, er erkrankt an der gefährlichen Pollenallergie.

Das gibt es nur im Big Apple und in dieser Animationsserie: Ein Zombie, ein Fantasy-Freak und ein ganz normaler Sozialarbeiter treffen in New York zusammen. Mark Lilly hat es nicht leicht. Sein Mitbewohner ist ein Untoter und die Chefin ein Dämon.

In vielen Fällen machen die sozialen Medien Menschen das Leben schwer. Ständig empfängt man Nachrichten aus der Familien-Whatsapp-Gruppe oder wird mit Videos konfrontiert. In der Sendung geht es darum, ob es überhaupt noch ohne "Social Media" geht.

Kyle, Mr. Garrison und Mr. Slave reisen nach New York, um den neuen metrosexuellen Wahn zu beenden. Dort erfahren sie, dass die angeblich schwulen Moderatoren in Wahrheit "Crab-People" sind, die mit dieser Modeerscheinung die Welt übernehmen wollen.

Gary zieht mit seiner mormonischen Familie nach South Park und besucht die Schule. Seine Freundlichkeit kommt bei den Freunden schlecht an, doch Stan ist mehr und mehr von der Familie begeistert, sodass auch sein Vater Randy Mormone werden will.

Die Gruppe Butt Out von der Anti-Raucher-Kampagne kommt nach South Park, um vor den Kindern eine Anti-Raucher-Show abzuziehen. Neben peinlichen Freestyle-Raps, blödem Beatboxing und uncoolen Tänzen haben die 4 Leute jedoch nicht viel zu vermitteln.

Stan ist schon sein ganzes Leben mit Wendy zusammen. Als sie ihm über Bebe ausrichten lässt, dass sie ihn verlässt, bricht für ihn eine Welt zusammen. Während er versucht, wieder mit ihr zusammenzukommen, tröstet sie sich schon mit einem anderen.

Jimmy macht bei den Paralympics mit, findet aber nicht zu seiner alten Form. Er besorgt sich Steroide und wird schnell süchtig nach Muskeln. Timmy versucht ihn zur Vernunft zu bringen, aber vergeblich. Am Ende sieht er seinen Fehler selbst ein.

Kenny, Stan, Kyle und Cartman setzen sich maximal für ihre neue Nachrichtensendung in der Schule ein. Die Konkurrenz ist aber sehr stark und sie können es mit Craigs Show nicht aufnehmen. Dann droht auch noch der Sender zu schließen.

Ein radikaler Dokumentarfilmer platziert eine lebende Kuh vor "Bob's Burgers", um ein Statement über Fast-Food und Fleischkonsum zu machen. Bob ist außer sich vor Wut, als die Anwesenheit des Rinds beginnt, seine Kunden zu vergraulen. Zur Überraschung aller ändert Bob bald seine Meinung und behandelt das Tier wie ein vollwertiges Familienmitglied.

Linda entdeckt, dass es Restaurants gibt, die sogenannte Krimidinner veranstalten. Das bedeutet, dass sowohl Essen serviert als auch begleitend eine Kriminalgeschichte von Laiendarstellern dargeboten wird. Nun möchte sie auch "Bobs Burgers" zumindest einmalig in ein solches Restaurant umwandeln. Widerwillig stimmt Bob zu. In der Premierennacht ändern einige unerwartete Unterbrechungen - unter anderem ein echter Überfall auf das Restaurant - den Verlauf des eigentlich geplanten Stücks.

Tina ist verzweifelt: Sie möchte zur Feier ihres 13. Geburtstages unbedingt ihren ersten Kuss mit einem Jungen zelebrieren. Dafür will sie ein Restaurant mieten und zu einer Party-Location mit Diskokugel und DJ umwandeln. Jimmy Pesto, der Besitzer, ist davon jedoch nicht begeistert und verbietet seinem Sohn, zu der Party zu gehen. Als Tina das erfährt, bricht für sie eine Welt zusammen. Bob versucht, seiner Tochter zu helfen.

Es steht ein langes Wochenende an. Linda beschließt, ein paar Zimmer ihrer Wohnung an Gäste zu vermieten. Dazu müssen Bob und die nicht begeisterten Kinder einige Zimmer hergeben. Doch es kommen nur seltsame Gäste, die man besser im Auge behält.

Francine möchte so wie in alten Zeiten mit der Familie in den Mittelalter-Freizeitpark "Familyland" fahren. Dort angekommen wird versehentlich der tiefgefrorene, böse Gründer des Parks, Roy Family, aufgetaut.

Roger verspricht Steve einen Gesichtstausch, damit der ein Date mit einer hübschen Mitschülerin bekommt. Doch er ändert spontan seine Meinung. Unterdessen sind Francine und Stan als Stewardessen unterwegs, um Mark Cuban auf die Schliche zu kommen.

Stan will, dass die Kinder mehr draußen spielen, allerdings verbietet Francine einen Ausflug. Also betäubt Stan die Kinder und nimmt sie mit auf das CIA-Holodeck. Hayley kauft außerdem Rogers Heimatstern, um seine Königin zu werden.
Malcolm hat bei den Proben zur Schulaufführung von diesem Jahr mit seiner Performance in Shakespeares Sommernachtstraum schauspielerisch so überzeugt, dass er die Hauptrolle spielen darf.

Francis will unbedingt seinen Geburtstag zu Hause verbringen - und das aus gutem Grund: Denn an der Militärakademie ist es üblich, dass an diesem Tag das Geburtstagskind am ganzen Körper rasiert und in einen Tümpel geworfen wird.
Aus Versehen hat Malcolm seiner Nachbarin, der sonderbaren und furchterregenden alten Hexe Mrs. Griffin, den Arm gebrochen.

Eine neue Mitschülerin zeigt Interesse an Malcolm, und auch er fühlt die Schmetterlinge im Bauch. Für Dewey ist es ein Schock, als Lois ihm seinen Teddy wegnimmt, weil sie das Kuscheltier zu unhygienisch findet.
Malcolms Familie bekommt neue Nachbarn. Anfangs läuft alles prima, man versteht sich blendend. Doch das ist nur die Ruhe vor dem Sturm.
Sam und Jay lassen die Geister übers Wochenende allein zu Hause, um sich einen Ausflug zu gönnen.
Pete entdeckt eine Kraft, von der er nie wusste, dass er sie hat, und die ihn Jay näher bringt.
Isaacs Nervosität an seinem Hochzeitstag wird durch die Ankunft eines Gastes noch verstärkt.
Gloria gewinnt ein Familienseminar und Haley und Alex kommen zusammen, um über Jungs zu reden.
Gloria mietet eine Hütte in den Bergen, wo die Familie ein perfektes Weihnachtsfest feiern kann.
Als Claire und Phil mit einem anderen Paar ausgehen, müssen die Dunphys die Rechnung bezahlen.
Claire hofft, den Entchen helfen zu können, auszuziehen, während Phil Alex am College besucht.
Claire beschließt, das Durcheinander im Haus aufzuräumen, bevor sie Jays Geschäft übernimmt.

Stan hat einen Auftrag betreffend die Occupy-Bewegung, da dort laut CIA-Informationen ein terroristischer Angriff einer linksgerichteten Zelle geplant wird. Als Stan zurückkehrt, glaubt Hayley, dass ihr Vater sich verändert hat.

Stan glaubt, dass Hayley alleine nicht lebensfähig wäre und lässt sie in Rogers Kneipe arbeiten, um praktische Erfahrungen für das Leben zu sammeln. Bei ihrem Job freundet sie sich mit Bullock an. Stan will diese Freundschaft für sich nutzen.
Stans Kollegen beim CIA bringen ihm die sogenannte "Rubbernecking"-Technik bei, mit welcher man in Gesellschaft der Ehefrau unbemerkt auch anderen interessanten Damen hinterherschauen kann.

Stan verliert seinen Job und muss sich etwas Neues suchen. Allerdings darf er seine 20 Jahre Berufserfahrung beim CIA nicht in seinen Lebenslauf schreiben und bekommt deshalb nur einen Job in einem Lebensmittelladen. Sein neuer Boss ist Steve.

Hayley hat einen Praktikumsplatz beim örtlichen Nachrichtensender ergattert und arbeitet dort für eine Reporterin. Diese Reporterin ist allerdings auf gewisse Weise außergewöhnlich. Es handelt sich bei ihr nämlich um den verkleideten Roger.

Als Bob erfährt, dass Lindas Mutter der Familie einen Besuch abstattet, gefällt ihm dies gar nicht. In Vorbereitung auf den hohen mütterlichen Besuch bringt Linda das Haus auf Vordermann und putzt wie eine Verrückte. In ihrem Putzwahn entdeckt sie zufällig ein Loch im Dach und bittet Bob es zu flicken. Dabei fällt Bob hinein und bleibt in den Zwischenräumen der Wände gefangen. Er spielt einen Geist, der im Restaurant herumspukt.
Ransom benutzt zu viel Desinfektionsgel, während Mariner paranoid wird, was Flüche angeht.
Das Unterdeck jagt Naniten in einem Hotel, das sich zufällig im Weltraum befindet.

Stan ist der festen Überzeugung, dass er das Zeug dazu hat, groß herauskommen zu können und im Reality-TV ein Star zu werden. Doch wie läuft dieses Unterfangen dann wirklich für ihn? Währenddessen legt sich Klaus einen Klaus zu.

Francine tritt Tuttles Gartenclub bei, was diesem missfällt. Er versucht, sie loszuwerden. Währenddessen experimentieren die anderen Familienmitglieder mit der "Kunst des Ja-Sagens", was zu unerwarteten und komischen Situationen führt.

Eine Reihe von Explosionen zerstört alle privaten Marihuanafelder und die Polizei verdächtigt den mexikanischen Joker für das Verbrechen. Kyle wird in ein Gefangenenlager gebracht, nachdem Cartman ihn bei der Einwanderungsbehörde gemeldet hat.
Als der Vereinssport Craigs Nachmittage und Wochenenden in Beschlag nimmt, meldet sich Tweek an, um mehr Zeit mit ihm zu verbringen. Schon bald hat seine ganze Familie Mühe, damit noch mitzukommen.
Die Solars sitzen in dem mit Stockfotos gefüllten Stockiverse fest.
Eine turbulente Spionage-Action-Episode, die sich in der Wand abspielt.
Als Beavis seinen Hintern verbrennt, muss er sich einer schmerzhaften Operation unterziehen.
Beavis und Butt-Head erhoffen sich, dass sie Frauen in der Apokalypse beeindrucken können.

Beavis und Butt-Head mittleren Alters posieren als Veteranen für Freibier, Beavis und Butt-Head versuchen reich zu werden, indem sie Hunde mit einem Waschbären züchten, den sie in einer Mülltonne gefunden haben. Ein absurder Plan mit Folgen.

Rick ist ein leicht gestörter Alkoholiker mit einer großen wissenschaftlichen Begabung. Er ist seit kurzer Zeit wieder mit seiner Familie zusammen und unternimmt mit Enkel Morty Ausflüge in den Weltraum, was nicht gut für Mortys Schulkarriere ist.
Rick, Morty und Summer reisen in ein anderes Universum, um einen grünen Kristall zu stehlen. Die Kinder müssen sich mit der Scheidung ihrer Eltern auseinandersetzen.
Monica prepares for a sexy Valentine's Day, but Chandler is too shell-shocked after accidentally viewing Rachel's birthing video. Meanwhile, Phoebe gives Joey the world's most cheerful dog.

A guilt-ridden Joey finally confesses his love for Rachel to the flabbergasted Ross, while Chandler becomes nervous when Phoebe's handsome new boyfriend Don shares numerous personality traits with Monica.
In an effort to restore normality to their friendship, Rachel tells Joey a big lie about her unborn child. Meanwhile, Phoebe's tea leaves reveal that she will soon encounter the man of her dreams.

Phoebe brings her irritatingly cheerful boyfriend to Mr and Mrs Geller's 35th anniversary party. Meanwhile, Ross is stunned when his parents ask him and the pregnant Rachel to feign marriage to avoid scandal.
South Park's politically incorrect past catches up with it when the new principal at South Park Elementary lays down the law and Cartman bears the brunt of his wrath.
Mr Garrison is crazy-mad about all the illegal immigrants in South Park, so it's time for a showdown with the familiar looking President of Canada! Cartman has other plans.
Gentrification hits South Park and Kenny's family take the brunt of it! Mr Kim's City Wok, also suffering, hires Kenny as part of their 'child labour force'!
There's a new craze in town, being a freeloading, online food critic! Kyle's dad and Cartman are leading the way! But just how much will the restaurants stand for?
When Cartman starts getting fat shamed on the internet, P.C. Principle steps in to save the day with the help of Steven Seagal! Meanwhile, Randy is enduring some charity shaming.
When Craig and Tweek are outed as gay, they're as surprised as everyone else. Sounds like it's time for Cartman's cupid self to work his magic, and maybe on Cartman too.
Jimmy, GK Barry and Jamali are passing judgement on some potential wrongdoers. Taking the stand tonight is a romantic gesture fail, and someone who refuses to date if the stars don't align.
Robert and Amy exchange vows in a wedding ceremony that has the Barone family tradition written all over it.
Debra convinces Ray to let her join him on the golf course after she once again realises that they don't have fun together any more.
Robert is caught in a compromising position by Amy's parents when they turn up unannounced at her flat.
When Robert is put in charge of selecting his wedding invitations, Ray suggests he intentionally botch the assignment so that Amy will let him off the hook with their wedding plans.
Ex-footballer Charlie Burrows leaves London with his daughter to start a new life in the country, keeping house for a female executive with a son.
Caroline is impressed with Charlie's work around the house, but he finds more than he bargained for in her bathroom.
Charlie is expecting someone for dinner - but so is Caroline.
Caroline's university reunion brings a visit from her old rival - who helps herself to whatever she fancies.
Caroline disapproves of Charlie's attitude towards the children's fighting, but a traumatic day forces her to eat her words.
Caroline and Charlie lie to new acquaintances.
Host Aisha Tyler joins comic regulars along with special guests comic Gary Anthony Williams and actor Yvette Nicole Brown as they perform improvised sketches prompted by ideas from the audience.
Host Aisha Tyler joins comic regulars along with special guests comic Jeff Davis and actor Gina Rodriguez as they perform improvised sketches prompted by ideas from the audience.

Joey is thrilled when his name is used in a 'Soap Opera Digest' crossword puzzle. He is reluctant to let the magazine do a profile of him, but Rachel tries to persuade him to reconsider so that he can mention her.

Monica and Phoebe host Rachel's baby shower but forget to invite her mother. Rachel realises she is clueless about caring for the baby after birth. Meanwhile, Joey auditions to host a new game show called 'Bamboozled'.

When Monica's cooking at the restaurant receives a harsh write-up in a newspaper, she goes to a criticism class taught by the reviewer, hoping to convince him to reconsider his opinion. Meanwhile, Rachel gets upset when a cute salesgirl flirts with Ross while he and Rachel are shopping for baby supplies, and nervous about a major job interview, Chandler receives some questionable coaching from Phoebe.
Eight days overdue, Rachel grows irritable, prompting a bet between Monica and Phoebe. Meanwhile, Joey invites Chandler to his new film's screening.
Rachel waits in the hospital maternity ward with an anxious Ross. To her dismay, she is put in a semi-private room. Then, the heavily pregnant Janice is assigned to share the room with her.
Rachel doubts Ross's commitment to her and the baby. Meanwhile, Ross wants to confess his love for Rachel. Joey discovers Ross's mother's engagement ring on the floor.

Detective Riggs and Murtaugh are called into action to foil a Chinese crime lord who is selling immigrants into slavery on American soil. The pair aren't as young as they used to be, and ending up on a Triad hit list doesn't make things easy for them either.

Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by Jack Dee, Claudia Winkleman, David O'Doherty and Josh Widdicombe as they thrash out the hot topics of the week by examining surveys, opinion polls and statistics.
Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by Richard Bacon, Gemma Collins, Katherine Ryan and Henning Wehn as they thrash out the hot topics of the week.
Aisha Tyler hosts another memorable episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Gary Anthony Williams.
Stand-up comedian Fern Brady brings her unique take on contemporary culture and the state of the UK to a packed crowd in Glasgow.
Beavis receives the worst news of his life. Middle-aged Beavis and Butt-Head pay a visit to their old friend Stewart.
Sara Pascoe, Alan Davies, Darren Harriott and sidekick John Kearns welcome Glenn Moore, Amy Gledhill, Ria Lina and Scarlett Moffatt to play another round of absurd guessing games.
Sal, Q and Murr are crashing and burning into product displays and hiding in tight spaces, but one of them must face the music with celebrity guest Bret Michaels.
The jokers give unsolicited etiquette advice and live tape strange product reviews; one lucky joker takes all the blame for celebrity guest Post Malone.

As Joey agonises over his secret affection for Rachel, Monica mistakenly thinks that he is infatuated with Phoebe. Meanwhile, Ross and Rachel promise not to try to find out the sex of their unborn child, but Rachel can't resist having a peek inside the doctor's confidential folder. Also, Monica urges a reluctant Chandler to enjoy the soothing pleasures of a scented bath, but realises that she's created a tub monster.

Joey rushes pregnant Rachel to hospital when she experiences pains. When Ross feels left out, Joey makes a gallant suggestion. Meanwhile, Chandler is surprised to discover what is behind the locked door of Monica's secret cupboard, and Phoebe gets the impression that Monica is enjoying one of her massages a little too much.

Due to a misunderstanding, Rachel finds herself engaged to Joey instead of Ross shortly after giving birth to her and Ross's baby girl. Meanwhile, Joey can't help taking a look as Rachel tries unsuccessfully to nurse her baby. Inspired to have a baby of their own, Monica and Chandler retire to a hospital cupboard for a little privacy.

Joey's futile attempts to gain Ross's forgiveness for mistakenly asking Rachel to marry him only result in emergency hospitalisation. Meanwhile, an exhausted Rachel desperately searches for a solution to end baby Emma's non-stop crying.

Rachel's constant calls to Emma's paediatrician force him to reject her as a patient. Meanwhile, Chandler plans to move to Tulsa for work, but worries about whether career-minded Monica is still willing to join him, and Joey and Phoebe agree to find each other companions for a double date.

Phoebe fears losing her latest prospective boyfriend Mike and her self-doubt is not helped by Ross' careless comments. Meanwhile, Chandler is in Tulsa on a work assignment, and when Monica surprises him in his hotel room, she mistakenly thinks that he has a sexual fetish for sharks.

While Phoebe and Joey wait at a fancy restaurant for their friends' arrival to celebrate Phoebe's birthday, Rachel is delayed because she is afraid to leave Emma with a babysitter. Monica and Chandler also fail to arrive on time after having a row about Chandler's urge to resume smoking and then giving in to other urges.
Ross mocks Rachel's new male nanny, and Chandler becomes upset when Monica says that somebody from her job is the funniest guy she's ever met.

When Chandler's former romantic rival intends to sell his flat, insecure Chandler persuades Joey to help him secretly inspect it and the guys are shocked to discover an old videotape featuring Monica having sex with Richard.

On the night before Thanksgiving, Rachel's self-centred younger sister Amy ruins everyone's holiday dinner with her uncensored observations. Meanwhile, Monica obsessively protects her good wedding china, and Joey forgets to join his television cast mates in the big Thanksgiving parade.

Rachel impulsively gives a handsome restaurant patron her telephone number, and worries that he'll call when Ross is in their apartment. Meanwhile, Phoebe's boyfriend Mike and Ross desperately try to find something in common to talk about when they babysit Emma, and Chandler returns from Tulsa to visit Monica, but must hide from Joey after rejecting his offer of free basketball tickets.

Chandler is forced to remain in Tulsa over the Christmas period due to a major deadline at work, and Monica fears the worst when she finds out that he will be joined in Tulsa by a beautiful colleague Wendy. While he works, Chandler recalls some of the more embarrassing moments from previous holidays shared with his friends.
Mr Bean goes Christmas shopping, conducts a Salvation Army band, and has Christmas dinner with his long-suffering girlfriend.
Mr Bean treats himself to a weekend at a posh hotel where he manages to get himself into one embarrassing situation after another.

A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.

Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run. Deputies get in a high-speed chase with a man wanted for shooting a motorway patrolman and stealing his cruiser; officers pursue a fugitive who's driving recklessly.

Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run. Deputies race to extract a mother and her daughters from their truck after a fleeing suspect crashes into them. And fish and wildlife officers pursue a fugitive attempting to escape by swimming.

A look at some of the country's strangest arrests: an off-duty pilot allegedly tries to shut down a plane's engine at 30,000 feet, a delivery driver is arrested for contaminating sandwiches, and an e-bike rider demands a lawyer.

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country: a golf cart cruises onto a moving walkway at the airport, a fraternity hazing leaves pledges half-naked in a basement, and a 70-year-old man drives his Cybertruck into a lake.
As his date with the executioner draws near, Ted Bundy offers to confess to eight Washington State murders.

Ted Bundy is finally executed in 1989; six years later Gary Ridgway is caught and charged with 40 Green River murders; when Ridgway confesses, Detective Robert Keppel realises how accurate Bundy's taped predictions were.
A beloved University of Kentucky football player is murdered on his doorstep during his 21st birthday party in an assassination-style killing.
When homesick university student Miya Marcano books a flight to South Florida for the weekend, her family is thrilled. However, when the plane lands, Miya is nowhere to be found.
Weeks after a pregnant woman is shot and killed in Orlando, a shootout between her suspected killer and a police officer sparks a manhunt.

Two cold cases, the 1992 murder of school teacher Christy Mirack in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, and the 1990 murder of Genevieve Zitricki in Greenville, South Carolina, were finally solved thanks to advancements in DNA technology.

Jennifer Pan was found guilty of staging a home invasion with the intention of killing her own parents. When her father awoke after surviving a gunshot wound, he was able to unpick the details of his daughter's sadistic plot.
A closer look at the case of Darren Byrne, a former city trader who killed his wife and then tried to burn down the family home after she discovered that he was having an affair.
Dermot Murnaghan explores the case of Lewis Daynes, who, at the age of 18, was sentenced to life in prison for the fatal stabbing of 14-year-old Breck Bednar.
...Murnaghan. New. The story of Ben Geen, who was convicted of murdering two patients in his care at Horton General Hospital. He maintains his innocence to this day. (S4, ep 8)

The quiet seaside town of Mablethorpe was an unlikely location for what appeared to be an organised hit on a couple in their 50s. Emilia travels to the Lincolnshire coast to learn about the violent murders of Joan and John Stirland in 2004.
Emilia uncovers details surrounding the brutal murder of Rosie Darbyshire. Witnesses and CCTV were key to solving the case that shocked the local community.
In April 2019, the remains of a woman were found in a freezer in a flat in London's East End. Investigators brought the freezer to be x-rayed, and it revealed two frozen bodies.
Laurent Bonomo and Gabriel Ferez are awoken in the middle of the night and tied up after Sonnex and Farmer climbed through an open window of their flat in New Cross, south London.

Shakira Spencer's death was the culmination of systematic cruelty by people she originally thought were friends. Shakira was isolated, tortured and abused at a time when people were rarely allowed to visit each other.
Kasim Lewis admits to killing Catherine Burke, 55, in a sexually inspired murder, while serving life for the murder of 22-year-old Iuliana Tudos.
Angela Cannings faces every parent's worst nightmare when she discovers her 18-week-old son, Matthew, unresponsive in his cot. By the time the ambulance crew arrive, he's already dead.
Following a violent attack that leaves a woman dead, police launch an urgent investigation. Detectives believe it's a robbery gone wrong and fix their sights on local burglar: Justin Plummer.

Suspected of a crime he knows nothing about, Andrew Malkinson agrees to help the police clear up the confusion. Convicted in 2004, Andrew never stopped protesting his innocence. Explore the case that continues to spark debate.
A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country. A naked man allegedly attacks police with a shovel, and a woman refuses to leave a restaurant until she gets a free glass of water.

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country: a naked woman attempts to elude police by jumping into the ocean; a man attacks a police car with a chainsaw; a woman claims her dad is Jesus Christ; and more!
An off-duty police officer shoots a man in the chest after a social event explodes into a deadly argument between the two men. The Defence believes this is a clear case of self-defence.

When beloved mother Janora Stevens is found brutally stabbed in her Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, her family is bitterly divided and increasingly suspicious of each other. The case chills until a trail of tell-tale fibres leads cops to her killer.
Live feed from Mecca every day that would enlighten our viewers by bringing visuals live from Islam's Holiest.
Melodious recitation of the Holy Qur'an with English translation.
Lesley Hazleton discusses humanity and where might be going wrong.
Documentary on small innovative houses and the pros and cons of them.

Lecture by Sh. Ahmad Saad on changing within yourself.
Discussion series hosted by Sh Ihsaan Taliep of IPSA. Discussions revolve around pertinent theological matters.

Presenting lectures on a variety of contemporary topics delivered by guests to Zaytuna College, aiming to educate and prepare morally committed professional, intellectual, and spiritual leaders grounded in the Islamic scholarly tradition.

A cameraman and presenter goes out and asks people in the CBD about their opinions on a particular matter. The public is free to say what they want to on the subject. Topics can range from political to 'Feel Good Stories.'

General and informative information on sports and health.
Documentary on Neanderthals, an extinct species of humans. The documentary looks into the scientific study of these beings of the past.

A jam packed business programme that delves into entrepreneurship, business development and the latest trends in the business world. Hosted by popular Radio show presenter and now TV presenter Nazreen Ebrahim.

Josh Gates hunts for the truth behind the world's most iconic and fascinating legends. Leaving no stone unturned, Josh's adventures take him around the globe and into dangerous situations as he dives in to uncover the truth behind enduring mysteries.
In Japan, Mike and Elvis take on a dream car, a 1990s Honda NSX. But a fundamental issue brings one of their biggest challenges ever.
Mike and Elvis are in Nagano to transform a cute old Suzuki Cappuccino, one of Japan's famed ultra-compact 'Kei cars', into a drifting track-star.

The Raneys head to West Virginia to rescue a mountaintop homestead with over 300 animals -- and no water. But the land and its owners are stubbornly resisting the necessary changes, making the rescue one of their biggest challenges yet.

Sig's crew races to jettison pots and repair a flooding compartment below deck. Rick radios Johnathan to help hide his honey hole, but when Jake spots the Time Bandit's unusual movements, he calls Rick's bluff.
Mike spots a bargain supercar, a Maserati 4200GT for under £10k. Under the hood is a Ferrari V8, but Elvis must try and fix the potentially costly gearbox and clutch issues.

Mike Brewer makes a return to the United Kingdom with Marc Elvis Priestley and find iconic cars to revive them before selling.
Marc resurrects a rusted Audi coupe from the 89s and brings it to the modern era again with new shiny technology.

Friends and natural builders set out to construct a family adobe dome home using the earth onsite in a mountain range in Calif; just as they get into a rhythm, Mother Nature hits them hard with heat waves, fires, earthquakes and a hurricane.

A young couple sets out to create their dream treehouse retreat in Northern Georgia overlooking the breathtaking Blue Ridge Mountains. Although the build calls for a mile-long, uphill trek, they hope it will go smoothly.
A family of five builds a forever home on their 46-acre land overlooking the Smoky Mountains.
A Big Island family finds their off-grid paradise threatened by destructive storms and deadly pests; to save them, the Raneys must get creative.
A Florida homestead is devastated by flooding and alligators; the Raneys find inventive ways to protect the homestead and bring in new food sources.
For families moving off-grid, the learning curve is steep. In a final effort to save their homesteads, they call in survival experts to prepare them for nature's worst.

The team transforms the Boneyard by enclosing part of the shed with walls; they finish off the new space by covering one wall with multi-colored barn wood; Mark explores a German house barn and visits a log home built on a cliff.
In Ystad, Stefan turns on the blue lights and chases a smuggler who is trying to escape. At Arlanda, Mimmi takes an X-ray of a man's bag when she sees something that looks like drugs.

As America marks its 250th birthday, reports of Revolutionary War ghosts draw Phil, Heather and Jack Osbourne to historic battlefields in Pennsylvania. Their investigation uncovers unsettling encounters at some of the nation's most storied sites.

The Silk Road was the ancient trade route that connected Eastern and Western worlds. The road travelled through many countries and was a source of ancient mystery. Even today, the road is shrouded in mystery.
Bruce goes to a Cold War underground bunker that has been converted to a museum. The curator is looking for some Soviet era equipment to tell the other side of the story.
Bruce hears about some second world war British airborne division gear from the battle of Arnhem for sale, which is of big interest to ex-paratroopers like him and Freddie.
Bruce Crompton marks the 75th Anniversary of VE Day, sending rare German half-track vehicles to partake in a battle re-enactment. In France, he seeks VE Day relics.

In Derbyshire, Henry and Fuzz visit Rob's haven of classic and rare bikes. They explore his collection of 1960s Lambretta scooters and 1920s 'flat tankers'.
In Lincolnshire, Henry and Fuzz trawl through Dave's eclectic mix of military, classic and agricultural items.
Henry and Fuzz meet Tim, a specialist bike restorer with a passion for all things British. Will they persuade him to part with a rare Triumph soft top?

A deadly design flaw results in a horrifying rush hour bridge collapse that tragically leaves 13 dead in Minneapolis. Using the latest science, experts investigate to reveal what went wrong on one of Minnesota's busiest crossings.

A Corvette disappears into a hole in the ground in the US state of Kentucky. In Australia, a disaster occurs during the construction of a huge bridge in the centre of Melbourne. Heavy construction work shakes the earth in Oklahoma.

A devastating rail disaster outside a small North Dakota town results in cargo erupting in massive explosions; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover an engineering flaw poised for catastrophic failure.
Following Bruce Crompton as he travels the globe to buy and sell wartime memorabilia.
Bruce hunts down relics of one of the greatest military commanders of all-time, George S. Patton. Then, he tries to close a deal worth £200,000.
After four years of careful restoration, Bruce races to get his Panther tank ready to ship to Australia. And, he discovers an interesting tank manual.
Henry Cole climbs aboard his Harley-Davidson Street Glide to brave the Friday night Sydney rush hour traffic and head 520 miles to Melbourne.
Henry Cole heads out from Apollo Bay to ride up towards Adelaide on one of the greatest roads in the world, 'The Great Ocean Road'.
Henry Cole faces his biggest challenge yet, crossing the infamous Nullarbor Plain, some 2000 kilometres of nothing.

The magnificent tomb of Alexander the Great mysteriously vanishes and becomes a legend; using CGI, investigators piece together the evidence to reveal where his tomb lies and what it might look like.

In 373 B.C., the Greek city of Helike vanished; archaeologists believe they've found the ruins of the great lost metropolis; using CGI, experts re-create the city's final moments and reveal its links to the greatest lost land of all -- Atlantis.
French polisher Alex tries to piece a grand Tudor style four-poster bed back together. Drew asks sculptor Nick to rescue a pair of decorative corbels and breathe some new life into them.
Arcade game expert Dr Pinball restores a rare 1940s American basketball game to its former glory. Artist Nick gets creative when he replasters and repaints a vintage life-size model bull.
Upholsterer, Craig, makes an attempt to save a pair of sofas used in the Dr Who TV series. Plus, blacksmith, Nev, turns a pair of street lamps into statement lights suitable for a home.

A team of experts and eyewitnesses seek answers about the Mothman creature. They explore theories that the legendary cryptid is an abnormality in the evolutionary chain, or even the result of an experiment gone horribly wrong.
Paranormal investigations reveal stunning new evidence about the Jersey Devil, a monster that prowls the Pine Barrens of New Jersey.

Most waterways of Alaska are still unexplored, and local folklore tells of hidden channels and monstrous beasts lurking in the depths. One of the most terrifying of all those beasts is said to live in Lake Iliamna.
A series of recent UFO sightings brings Chuck Zukowski's team to Missouri, the home of the 1973 Piedmont lights incident. Armed with new evidence, they tackle whether history is repeating itself.

How do they power the next generation of race cars that run on electricity? Plus, how do they make mead - the favourite drink of the infamous Vikings?
New research shows the migration of ice planets may have helped start life on Earth, and stopped it being destroyed. How are they so vital?

How do they make the distinctive Borsalino hat worn by Indiana Jones? And, how do they make a bicycle which can fold up to a tenth the size of a regular bike?
How do they make the world's most famous electric guitar, the Fender Stratocaster, and how do they make Swedish fermented cod roe 'Kalles Caviar'?
Using material salvaged from scrapyards, Adam and two colleagues design and build three motorised monsters of destruction, inspired by post-apocalyptic worlds.
Adam wants to build his own version of King Arthur's legendary sword - Excalibur. Using the iron found in a meteorite, he attempts to make an indestructible weapon.
Neutron stars are violent phenomena that defy the laws of physics. New discoveries reveal they are far more deadly than previously believed and have the power to destroy planets and even other stars.
Supernovas are the violent death of giant stars, and new discoveries reveal that these cataclysmic events create the elements that are essential to all life in the universe.
Insight into the production processes of wooden matches, tillage machines, telescopic gangways, and mabe pearls.
Find out how mosquito coils, solar-assist tricycles, palm oil, and fibreglass chopper guns are made and why they are so in demand.

Legendary places of protection, from a historic military fortress in Gibraltar and Pablo Escobar's secret Colombian hideaway to a floating kingdom on Peru's Lake Titicaca.

New discoveries might finally explain the truth behind one of the Triangle's most infamous mysteries, when 306 US Navy crewmen vanished without a trace.
Richard finds a classic mini that needs restoring. And, with the costs of the new workshop escalating, he sells some of his own cars to help pay for the business.
The original Countach was the supercar of the 1970s. 50 years later, Lamborghini have created a new version with some electricity thrown in. Plus, the team test the BMW i4 M50.
The team test-drive the Kia 600hp EV6 the length of Norway, along the E6, Europe's longest road in a single country. Plus, Jason drives a Tesla SUV against a Porsche Macan.
The team test the Porsche Taycan, a sports car that gets to 62 mph in 2.8 seconds and up to 162 mph. And, Jimmy goes to Sweden to sample Volvo's plans to revolutionise trucking.
Farmtruck and AZN gather another group of local racers in North Carolina. The last racer standing will get a chance to race against Justin Swanstrom.

The pursuit of profit sees Henry and Fuzz rummaging through Rebecca and Sue's sheds near Newark. It's home to all manner of vehicles and parts.

The boys set their sights on Mexico where Beetle fanatic Elvis wants to build a jacked-up Baja Bug for racing across sand dunes. But with just five days to complete the build and costs racking up Mike's worried Elvis may be getting carried away.

Mike and Elvis head to sun-drenched Portugal where the iconic, beach-friendly Mini Moke has earned cult status. It's a car with a very special place in Mike's heart. But severe water damage and chronic rust makes it a total restoration job.

Mike and Elvis take a gamble as they head to Germany and buy a neglected Audi RS2 that they can't test drive. This highly collectable estate car could earn them a bumper profit, but it could also turn into a €40k money pit.

Bike guru Henry Cole and ace mechanic Sam Lovegrove reminisce on their Best Bits from the last two series of 'Shed & Buried'. This time round, the two look back at their visit to Peter Bullen, a trials car enthusiast.

Bike guru Henry Cole and ace-mechanic Sam "The Engine Whisperer" Lovegrove remember their visit to Eamon's place in Oxfordshire, where they were searching for vintage treasure to restore.

Richard gambles his own money on a 1970 Mark II Jensen Interceptor with plans to restore it to factory specification. Plus, the guys head to the London Classic Car Show.

Ein Team von Weltklasse-Show-Wrestlern bietet den Fans zum ersten Mal seit 20 Jahren ein neues Wrestling-Erlebnis. Mit von der Partie sind Cody und Brandi Rhodes, Kenny Omega, Henker Adam Page, Chris Jericho und Jon Moxley.

Ein Mann hat auf offener Straße die Fensterscheiben einer Bar eingetreten. Der Rowdy wollte sich offenbar dafür rächen, dass er aus dem Lokal geworfen wurde. Bei seiner Festnahme wehrt er sich heftig.

Paul Bertram und sein Polizeikollege Matt Bland suchen nach einem verdächtigen Fahrzeug. Der Wagen wurde vermutlich bei einem Verbrechen eingesetzt, bei dem es auch zu einer Messerattacke gekommen sein soll.
In Chemnitz sind in dieser Folge Körpereinsatz, Konzentration und Nervenstärke gefragt.
In dieser Folge verschanzt sich in Potsdam eine Person in einer brennenden Hütte.

Am Airport Madrid-Barajas muss ein Mann aus Costa Rica eine intensive Kontrolle durchleben. Auf dem Röntgenscanner konnten die Zollbeamten nämlich erkennen, dass sich in seinem Laptop etwas befindet, was dort nicht hingehört.

Eine 48-jährige Lastkraftwagenfahrerin hat den Lkw-Führerschein ursprünglich gemacht, um ihre Pferde zu Wettkämpfen zu transportieren. Inzwischen transportiert sie hauptberuflich unterschiedlichste Ware mit ihrem Lastkraftwagen.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Josh sucht nach einem streng geheimen Wasserflugzeug aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg, das im Pazifik abstürzt ist. 70 Jahre später schließt er sich einem Team an, das den Meeresboden in Hunderten Metern Tiefe durchsucht, um den verlorenen Schatz zu finden.

Die Ameisen schmecken widerlich, aber Jermaine darf bei der Nahrungsauswahl nicht wählerisch sein, denn sein Körper benötigt Proteine. Und auch kleine Mengen können am Ende den Unterschied ausmachen. Was baut unterdessen eine Flusskrebs-Falle.
Wer bringt sein Wasser schneller zum Kochen? Die Bushcraft-Profis aus Australien und den Südstaaten der USA treten in Südafrika bei einem Ausscheidungswettkampf gegeneinander an.

Amazonas-Bezwinger Ed Stafford geht in der Wildnis bis an seine Grenzen. In dieser Doku-Serie versucht der Survival-Spezialist zehn Tage lang an den gefährlichsten Orten der Welt zu überleben - ohne Kompass, Ausrüstung und Proviant. Auf seinen gefährlichen Trips ins Okavangodelta, in den Regenwald Borneos und die Tafelberge in Venezuela bewegt sich der Brite auf gefährlichem Terrain.

In dieser Folge bekommen es Luke Purdy und seine Crew auf Stradbroke Island mit einem acht Tonnen schweren Boot zu tun. Die 12 Meter lange Jacht ist in einem geschützten Mangroven-Gebiet, das der indigenen Bevölkerung gehört, auf Grund gelaufen.

Brett und Sahra sind verzweifelt. Der einzige Zugang zu ihrer Farm wurde bei einem Hochwasser fortgespült. Und wenn ihre Macadamianuss-Ernte nicht innerhalb der 24 Stunden zur Weiterverarbeitung abtransportiert wird, verlieren sie rund 15 000 Dollar.

Tropenstürme haben in der nördlichen Region zwei versunkene Autowracks freigelegt. Die Vehikel stellen eine Bedrohung für die Umwelt dar, denn in dem Reservat legen bedrohte Meeresschildkröten ihre Eier ab und müssen deswegen geborgen werden.

Claes und seine Kollegin befragen in Stockholm eine ältere Frau. Die Dame macht einen verwirrten Eindruck. Sie hält sich schon seit drei Tagen am Flughafen auf und will in die USA reisen, um dort eine Online-Bekanntschaft zu treffen.
Claes versucht, am Stockholmer Flughafen eine angespannte Situation zu entschärfen. Ein Reisender verhält sich aggressiv und weigert sich, mit den Sicherheitskräften zu sprechen.

Enorm hohe Betriebskosten: Parker Schnabel gibt pro Woche fast eine Million Dollar aus. Gleichzeitig sinkt die Goldausbeute. Seine Hauptsorge gilt der „Goldenen Meile". Rick Ness und seine Crew bewegen unterdessen gigantische Mengen an Erdreich.
Tony Beets bekommt Besuch. Sein jüngerer Bruder Klaas ist zu Gast in Nordamerika. Die beiden Männer sind zusammen auf einer Milchfarm in den Niederlanden aufgewachsen.

Ein Freund hat die Machereys damit beauftragt, herauszufinden, ob sich im Northern Territory Australiens Gold finden lässt. Doch die extreme Hitze und die mangelnde Infrastruktur sorgen bei dieser Aufgabe für einige Probleme.

Nachdem Andreas Macherey Goldnuggets gefunden hat, geraten er und sein Sohn Tobi in einen Goldrausch. Um mehr Nuggets zu finden, wollen sie die Umgebung mit einer Drohne kartieren. Doch dabei müssen sie auf Wasserbüffel aufpassen.

Das Grauen ist noch immer allgegenwärtig: Die Häftlinge auf der ehemaligen Gefängnisinsel Spike Island mussten schreckliche Dinge erleiden, obwohl einige von ihnen während der Hungersnot lediglich ein Brot gestohlen hatten.
Ignacia suffers from a facial tumour that could asphyxiate her. Thomas has a rare bone eating disease that has destroyed the left side of his torso.
In India, baby Chahat weighs as much as a six-year-old. Her family travel 2000 kilometres to see a top obesity expert. In Spain, Juana is allergic to the outside world.
Wayne takes his newly restored 1964 Ferrari Lusso and 1957 Mercedes 300SL Gullwing to auction at Scottsdale.

Wayne's selling two muscle cars at the Mecum Auction in Kissimmee. Whilst he is there he cannot resist bidding for two vintage Jeeps and a Chevy pickup.

With plans for a live restoration at CarFest to restore the cog's mojo, as well as a new girlfriend for 'Oliver', Richard has concerns for the workshop's prospects. Even with a higher rate job in hand, the future doesn't look certain.
A local Pastor needs some divine intervention for his 1974 Ford Bronco. the Garage Squad will try their best to get this car out of garage hell.
A 1972 Chevy Nova that has been in the family for three generations has seen more than its share of rough patches. Can the team bring it back to glory?
Jeremy Wade investigates if one of the Bermuda Triangle's most infamous disappearances was part of a conspiracy by a secret agent at war with the US.

A man displays an unseen video from 1992 and in Texas, several eyewitnesses document a UFO sighting. Meanwhile, in Utah, an individual records footage of a hovering object in the sky.

Jess and Phil dive deeper into the tragic history of Fort Morgan; haunting bell sounds beyond the Fort's walls trigger a dangerous search in the churning waters off Alabama's coast; "Kindred Spirits'" Amy Bruni and Adam Berry join the investigation.

Outdoors-loving Richard is planning an ambitious mountain-top wedding blessing hundreds of miles away in Wales for his home-loving bride-to-be Jody, when all she dreams of is a local white wedding surrounded by her friends and family. But with even his best man needing convincing his outdoor idea is a good one, Richard has a real uphill battle on his hands.

Roller hockey-mad Luke faces the biggest game of his life when he plans a wedding for his traditional, family-orientated bride-to-be Jaydene. Big kid Luke wants a wedding that's all about fun, while his bride just wants a traditional wedding in the same church that her parents and grandparents were married in.
Jonathan tackles a budget-friendly renovation for Jessica and Taylor's home for 16 years, ahead of the large extended family all moving on in new directions.

Lisa and Chris bought their Nashville home six years ago, but with four kids and Grandma all squeezed under one roof, it's time to overhaul their log-cabin interiors so they can afford a bigger nest. Jonathan gears up for a radical renovation.
In Lincolnshire and Yorkshire, there's a one-man comedy show, a posh take on some Yorkshire classics, and a big surprise in store for one guest.

His own family are concerned that the restaurant is becoming trapped in the past, but Peter is determined to stick to his guns.

Gordon heads to the Prohibition Grille in Everett, Washington, where he meets a belly dancer-turned-restaurateur named Rishi Brown. As a boss, Rishi is making all the wrong moves and her lack of experience is evident everywhere.

Stung by his mother's suggestion that he is 'not normal', Greg puts everyone else under the microscope in a petty quest to discover if anyone actually is.

A compilation edition of the panel show hosted by Jimmy Carr with team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson. Guests include Jo Brand, David O'Doherty, Katherine Ryan, Jerry Springer, Roisin Conaty and Johnny Vegas.

This time on Gogglebox it's 'The Great Celebrity Bake Off for Stand Up To Cancer', 'With Love', 'Meghan', 'Tempting Fortune', 'Fear', 'Bradley Walsh: Egypt's Cosmic Code', 'Last One Laughing', 'Jeopardy' and 'This Morning (toenails)'.
Eternal singleton Nicole is determined not go down the same path as a Bridget Jones. At first glance, chartered surveyor Gary is no Mr Darcy, but he assures Nicole that this doesn't make him boring.

Celebrations are in order as Haley turns 21 and, while the grown-ups hit a bar, Alex, Manny and Luke are left to babysit Lily.

Gordon travels to Philadelphia to visit a Mexican restaurant called Zocalo. At one point, this restaurant played Cupid to a young couple who met, fell in love and married while working here together. Greg and Mary Russell loved the place so much that they pooled their resources and bought it. However, it seems that Cupid's arrow had a poisoned tip: the restaurant has become an albatross around their necks.

Gordon Ramsay travels to Fremont, California, to try to save a restaurant that is tearing the owners' marriage apart. From Wakefield, West Yorkshire, Michael visits the National Coal Mining Museum for England at Caphouse Colliery. He pauses to admire the tall spire of Wakefield Cathedral and its resident peregrine falcons before heading to the banks of the Calder.

Michael Portillo resumes his tour of the Home Counties in the picturesque and historic county town of Guildford. His 1936 Bradshaw's guide commends its 'fine old castle keep' and guildhall but makes no mention of its hilltop cathedral. Michael meets head guide Janet Matthews to discover the origins of the first Anglican cathedral to be built on a new site in the south of England since the Reformation, begun in 1936.

Michael Portillo continues his post-war exploration of North West England in Bradford, Shipley and Hebden Bridge. In Centenary Square in Bradford, Michael encounters the literary giant JB Priestley, author of `An Inspector Calls'.

Michael stops at rural Mattoon, where he gets a taste of the tough early life, which shaped President Abraham Lincoln. Wiping the sweat from his brow, Michael struggles to split one rail compared with Lincoln's estimated 700-a-day.

Fred's fascinating journey through Britain's industrial past sees him tracing the development of the railways, from the first steam locomotive to the record-breaking Mallard. The excitement reminds him of his childhood days when locomotives used to roar past his bedroom window, and Fred gets his hands dirty stoking the boiler of a Black Five as he speeds through the Welsh countryside.

Fred moves on to the golden age of shipbuilding, examining the skills of engineers who turned Britain into one of the foremost manufacturing nations. He also visits the world's first production line in Suffolk.
Fred visits Cornwall to explore its key place in the early history of the steam engine. In Cornwall, Fred illustrates how the county's tin mining industry utilised steam engines to pump water.

Fred Dibnah explores the revolutionary impact of steam engines on rail transport. In the process, Fred examines both the earliest colliery railways and the end of steam power on commercial railways in the 1960s.

Martin's travels take him 1,500 miles to the San Juan Islands in Washington State, just off America's North West Pacific coast, right on the border with Canada. There are more than 100 islands, mostly uninhabited. From the Channel Islands, Martin takes a 2,000-mile journey across the States to Louisiana.

Having honed their survival strategies over millennia, mammals have evolved to be masters of the cold. From icy seas to snow-capped mountains, a look at the unique mammals that call these frozen worlds home.
